subject.title: [Bug] Telegram exec approval bubble not dismissed after clicking approve

question: Should maintainers close the conflicting linked fork PR and authorize a narrow replacement fix for this issue?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but an open fork PR still claims the issue with closing syntax while targeting removed handler code and carrying unrelated edits, so automation should not queue a second fix until that candidate is resolved.

options.title: Close fork and queue replacement
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork PR, then allow a narrow fix against `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with Telegram proof.

options.title: Adopt fork manually
options.body: A maintainer can manually salvage the fork's useful idea, but most of the branch still needs replacement because it targets obsolete code.

options.title: Wait for contributor
options.body: Keep waiting on the fork author, accepting that this valid Telegram bug remains open with no clean same-repo landing path.

recommendation.title: Close fork and queue replacement
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork PR, then allow a narrow fix against `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current native approval lifecycle and are the strongest history-backed routing candidate for deciding the replacement path.
